name: Arvin
aboutImageAlt: Photographer at work on a mountain ridge above the clouds
lede: I photograph the quiet seconds between moments — people, places, and the light that ties them together.
statement: For twelve years I have chased the same thing: the half-second where light, gesture and place line up and something true slips through the shutter. I work slowly, shoot fast and edit without mercy. Portraits, landscapes, editorial — honest frames, never staged to death.

kit.label: Light
kit.detail: Two battery strobes, one big octa, a lot of patience

kit.detail: Raw developer, colour-managed monitor, darkroom habits
